name: How long does a typical exterior improvement consultation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical exterior improvement consultation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical residential exterior improvement consultation usually takes about 30 to 90 minutes, depending on the size and complexity of your home and the number of areas requiring assessment. During this time, our experts will thoroughly inspect your property and answer any questions you have. The duration can vary if multiple issues, such as roofing and siding damage, need to be evaluated across a larger property.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical consultation lasts 30-90 minutes, varying with home size and complexity, allowing for a thorough inspection and discussion.
